skill_name: Write a creative story that starts with the phrase "The sun was setting in the west".
workflow: The sun was setting in the west, painting the sky a brilliant mix of pink, orange and red. From the top of the hill, an old man and his dog watched with admiration. The old man sighed as he thought back to the times when life had been different and times were simpler. He took a deep breath, savoring the moment before turning back to his farmhouse.
